summary: Iteration 14 hotfix verified: (1) Null-safe member search across Puan Ekle single+bulk modes and Filtrele-ve-Düzenle section — typed queries into all 4 search inputs with no TypeError. (2) BottomNav tab label 'KOMUTAN BİLGİLERİ' verified in TR default and all 8 locales (en/ru/de/fr/es/ko/ar/tr) via LanguageSwitcher — all match expected translations. (3) Members sort by name (A→Z) applied without crash, PointsList & Commanders navigate cleanly. (4) Backend regression pytest: 2/2 PASS (PATCH /api/scores, GET /api/export/xlsx Sıralama sheet).
critical_code_review_comments: AddPoints.jsx line ~177 renders <span> inside <option> (due to LiveEditor instrumentation on {e.name}). React logs a hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. This is a pre-existing dev-mode warning (present before iteration 14, unrelated to null-safety hotfix). Consider wrapping event.name in a plain string, e.g. `{String(e.name || '')}`, to silence and future-proof — currently harmless in production.

Null-safety pattern is now consistent: (m.name || '').toLowerCase() and (m.member_id || '').includes() applied in AddPoints (2 sites), Commanders (2 sites), PointsList (1 site), Members cmp uses `an = a.name || ''` before localeCompare, Leaderboard already null-safe. Good coverage.

Leaderboard.jsx was NOT in the referenced change list but sort still uses r.name via slice/sort in prior iterations — verify it also guards against null names if any member.name could be null (spot-check appeared safe during navigation).
seed_data_creation: None — did not need to create null-name member; existing 155 members exercised the guarded code paths, and typed queries like 'a', 'xyz', 'test', 'z' triggered all branches without crash.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 14 hotfix accepted. Null-safe guards in place at AddPoints:35,288 / Commanders:708,773 / PointsList:25 / Members:110-119 cmp. All 8 i18n nav_commanders values verified live in browser (TR: KOMUTAN BİLGİLERİ, EN: Commander Info, RU: Информация о командирах, DE: Kommandanten-Info, FR: Info Commandants, ES: Info Comandantes, KO: 지휘관 정보, AR: معلومات القادة). Only lingering console warning is a React hydration warning about <span> inside <option> on AddPoints event dropdown — pre-existing, not related to this iteration, cosmetic only.
rca of the issue: Prior TypeError 'Cannot read properties of null (reading includes)' was thrown when a member document had null/undefined name or member_id and code called .toLowerCase().includes() / .includes() on the raw field. Fix: wrap every field access with (field || '') fallback across all 5 pages. Verified with 4 different search-input interactions across single/bulk/filter sections — zero TypeErrors captured via page.on('pageerror') and console-error listeners.
